test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2' **i.e.** 'I'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sentence reads**, "My mom and (4) ______ are in the kitchen."
 
• In** this context,** we need a pronoun that can stand alongside "my mom" as the subject of the sentence.
 
• The **pronoun needs to be** in the subject form because it is doing the action (being in the kitchen).
 
• **I:** This is a subject pronoun and can be used as a subject in a sentence. It fits perfectly into this context.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *Today I have a college admission interview with a Yale alum. Yale is Second-Best School, but for once, I put my foot down and Refused to apply to Best School (Harvard). The idea of being Charlie’s younger brother at another school is a bridge entirely too far. Besides, who knows if Harvard would even take me now that Charlie’s been suspended. My mom and **I** are in the kitchen. Because of my interview, she’s steaming frozen mandu (dumplings) for me as a treat. I am having a pre-mandu appetizer of Cap’n Crunch (the best cereal known to mankind) and (5) ______ in my Moleskine notebook.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's evaluate the options:
 
 
• **Me: **This is an object pronoun and cannot be used as a subject in a sentence.
 
• **Am: **This is a form of the verb "be" and cannot be used as a subject in a sentence.
 
• **Myself: **This is a reflexive pronoun and is used when the subject and object of the verb are the same person. It does not fit in this context.
